ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This course section is restricted to degree seeking students admitted to the undergraduate BS in HORT program. To receive credit for this course offering, students must register for both the HORT 298 BS1 lecture and HORT 298 BS2 laboratory sections of the Illinois Field Botany course. Field trips will be arranged with students on May 30, June 13, June 27, and July 11 (locations and times will be announced after they have been determined). Enrolled students are required to have a working microphone and speakers, or a headset with speakers and a microphone, and a high speed internet connection.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: AO Fees 2+4 $41.00 per Bill Hour, and AO Tuition 2+4 $305.00 per Bill Hour.
